author: SirCyaniide
body:
So recently I've noticed how Clay Wars has been loosing popularity, and getting a lot of hate. This post will target the main reasons why in MY opinion Clay Wars is loosing popularity, and how we can fix it.

Monuments

       The monuments are too close to spawn, as you all know its rare for this map to end early, and the reason to this is how the monuments are placed. They give the opposing team a huge disadvantage due to the fact that the monuments are of arms reach away.
       Say you got to their monument and you're all set, you've killed all the defenders and you're the only person there. It would take them less than 5 seconds to get back to their monument because of how close the spawn is. This issue mostly causes stalemates, and will take a lot of time out of the game to get to the monument. This issue is probably the main reason why Clay Wars takes so long.



Resources 

       I would like to see this added in the map. Now when I say resources, I don't mean we should add diamonds and potions to make it more intense, but I was thinking of maybe adding some iron and wood.

      The iron can be limited to 12 blocks per team, and there can be something like a chest in the middle on each side that is full of wood. I don't want us to spawn with wood just because its fun having limited resources on this map, and it creates an atmosphere of survival, and team work because of how limited each team is to its resources.

      These two are the main issues I can come up with that prevent this map from being fun, and in my opinion this should be fixed. Please know that Clay Wars's terrain is great for Pvp, and the limited resources adds a vibe of working together. But I've also seen flame wars occur because of how long the map takes, and how some people try to end it by team griefing.


Hopefully this post wont get any hate [Again this is just my opinion], but I think its important to put it out there on how this map needs some tweaking.
